summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares on June 16, 2026. The company purchased 2,632,073 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 103.6345 pence per share, with a range of 102.70 to 103.90 pence. These purchases are part of an existing share buyback program announced on January 30, 2026, and the shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. The buyback reduces share count and boosts EPS. Watch for completion of the program and potential accretion for remaining shareholders.
